columns.name: number_of_seasons_played
columns.description: The number of seasons the goalie has played, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: has_more_lost_than_won_games
columns.description: Set to 1 if the goalie has more lost than won games, otherwise, set to 0

columns.name: total_goal_againsts
columns.description: The total number of goals against by the goalie, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: played_5000_minutes_in_the_all_the_season_played
columns.description: Set to 1 if the goalie has played 5000 minutes in total across all the seasons played, otherwise, set to 0

columns.name: defensive_success_rate_in_the_postseason_of_2011
columns.description: The defensive success rate (in percentage) of the goalie in the postseason of 2011

columns.name: num_victories
columns.description: The number of victories the team has across all the seasons played, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: highest_total_points_got_in_a_year
columns.description: The highest total points the team got in a year.

columns.name: power_play_percentage_in_2011
columns.description: The power play percentage of the team in 2011.

columns.name: num_bench_minor_penalties
columns.description: The number of bench minor penalties the team has across all the seasons played, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: num_ties
columns.description: The number of ties the team has across all the seasons played, replace NULL values with 0.
